limitations: The original matrix incorrectly said RS in two descriptive strings. Both actual attention GEMMs use shared-memory descriptors (SS); WGMMA_RS is inert here. Historical snapshots are unchanged and the erratum plus description-only correction identify the scope.
These seeded ordinary cases do not establish P02 exceptional-value, rounding, layout, numerical cancellation or general dtype/shape coverage.
SimX is a software model. Native processor rtlsim bypasses the AFU and does not qualify vendor XRT hw_emu, physical FPGA operation or silicon.

Per-case binary hashes were observed during execution; later cases overwrite shared build outputs. Final attention binaries were independently rehashed, while earlier binary payloads are not retained in the repository.
The six-case run reuses and reconfigures the initially fresh generated build; separate P01-A01 evidence supplies a new generated-build smoke.
Raw nested hashes identify original bytes; the export manifest reconciles sanitized logs and snapshots. Simulated cycle counts and command durations are not physical performance measurements.
